prompt:
Create ONE high-detail production TEXTURE ATLAS for four related StarCraft II Marine card paintings. Wide landscape PNG, 16:9, ideally 4096x2304. The atlas has EXACTLY FOUR EQUAL VERTICAL COLUMNS, ordered left to right. Every column is a SEPARATE painting with its OWN empty environment on top and ONE transparent full-body unit beneath. No lines, frame, UI, numbers, letters, labels, logo, watermark or fake checkerboard.
LAYOUT STRICT: each column spans 25% image width. Upper 30% height in each column: its environment painting, with absolutely NO soldier or character part. Between 30% and 38% height: transparent empty gap. Lower area from 39% to 94%: exactly ONE complete Marine cutout, including full helmet, weapon and boots. Its body and effects must be wholly within its own column with at least 7% of column width left/right margin. Never let units, rifles or flashes cross column boundaries. Outside cutouts the entire lower area has genuine transparent alpha. Use generous local margins and a slight angled rifle pose so the full gun fits. Four total Marines, one per column, no other beings.
STYLE shared across all four: sophisticated SC2 campaign cinematic digital painting, realistic adult proportions, weighty rounded blue CMC power armor, mechanical collar, amber glass visor, rich scratched metal and fabric detail, controlled highlights and shadow. This must read as mature StarCraft illustration, never flat vector, cartoon, toy, low-poly or a screenshot of a gameplay model. Material details should remain crisp when the individual column is cropped to a card. Environments and matching units share lighting color and direction.
COLUMN 1 ORDINARY MARINE: standard C-14 gauss rifle, balanced alert forward step, standard blue rounded shoulder plates. Environment: cold colony street entrance, damaged concrete cover, wet steel and restrained amber distant fire.
COLUMN 2 STIM ASSAULT MARINE: clearly visible GREEN injection hardware/tubes on the shoulder and backpack, a lean aggressive running stance and a raised rifle, retain recognizably Marine armor. Environment: narrow forward medical resupply corridor opening onto a smoky street, green emergency lamps and pale mist. This is an assault soldier, not a medic; do not add a healer staff.
COLUMN 3 HEAVY-FIRE MARINE: visibly LARGE long-barreled belt-fed heavy rifle, readable linked ammunition belt, planted braced firing posture, small complete warm muzzle flash ending well within column. Environment: ruined industrial breach scarred by a broad pattern of heavy bullet impacts, hot sparks and warm smoke. Weapon and pose must differ clearly from the standard rifle and assault pose.
COLUMN 4 HEAVY-ARMOR MARINE: substantial overlapping chest armor and much broader layered reinforced shoulder plates, heavy knee/leg armor, steady guarded upright stance, standard rifle. Environment: battered armored bunker entrance, shell fragments, cold hard metallic bounce light. No shield bubble or physical shield; identity is heavy ARMOR.
Distinct scene, silhouette/gear and action in each column. Only color changes are not enough. All four complete units must remain separated below their empty scenes with true alpha.
layout: four vertical columns, environment above, transparent complete unit below
